entries: Added a count such as "2 of 5" to the permission prompt when several permission requests stack up
Added mouse support for the "N more" rows of lists in fullscreen mode: click one to jump to that end of the list, with hover and pressed states
Fixed several Claude Code processes and IDE extensions each opening a login browser when gcpAuthRefresh or awsAuthRefresh credentials expire
Fixed `claude --resume` and `--continue` sometimes losing every turn after a batch of parallel tool calls when the earlier session crashed or was killed
Fixed API 400 errors after a tool or hook returned an object, number or boolean instead of text, including in resumed sessions
Fixed cloud sessions with very large histories never waking up because the container was stopped while the transcript was still loading

Fixed the Claude apps gateway's spend meter pricing 1-hour prompt cache writes at the cheaper 5-minute rate, and counting only the first model call's input tokens on streamed turns that run a server-side tool such as web search
Fixed macOS sessions still showing "Not logged in" or "Login expired" after `/login` succeeds in another Claude Code window when a leftover `~/.claude/.credentials.json` exists
Fixed every turn failing when the Anthropic API refuses the model your default or a model alias resolves to: Claude Code now retries once on the previous model of the same tier
Fixed Remote Control sessions (including `claude remote-control`) staying connected after your organization's policy turns Remote Control off; they now disconnect with a notice
Fixed refusal and `--fallback-model` retries failing when the fallback model can't run fast; they now run at standard speed, with a one-time notice in interactive sessions
Fixed headless sessions repeating the "MCP servers require authentication" reminder after a successful re-authentication when the MCP discovery cache is enabled
Fixed `claude auth status` reporting a Console sign-in's stored API key as `claude.ai`; it now reports `api_key`, and the VS Code extension treats that session as an API key session
Fixed `/status` listing an Anthropic profile beside an API key as if both were in effect; the profile is now marked as not in use
Fixed Claude not being told when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control did not arrive, and a file sometimes getting only 10 seconds for its last download try
Fixed a Remote Control message that arrived while Claude Code was exiting being marked delivered and then never answered; it now stays queued for the session's next run
Fixed MCP error messages showing a credential's value when "Bearer" or "Basic" came before its key name
Fixed percent-encoded Bearer tokens being only partly masked in error messages
Fixed redacted logs and transcripts showing a secret whose key name has an invisible character inside, such as a zero-width space

Fixed logs and transcripts showing part of a URL password that contains punctuation such as `)`, quotes, `]`, `&` or a second `@`, or that runs past a `/` to a bracketed host such as `[::1]` in an ssh URL
Fixed the session transcript in the zip that `/feedback` saves to disk containing invalid JSON lines after secret redaction
Fixed MCP connectors listing no tools for up to a day after their server dropped the older MCP handshake
Fixed a repeat MCP sign-in request from Claude replacing the pending sign-in link, which could stop that link from working
Fixed `/usage` not crediting an MCP server for a tool call made while that server was still connecting or had only just connected, such as right after a restart
Fixed plugins enabled on claude.ai occasionally going missing from Claude Code for a session after a transient server error
Fixed a message typed into a running subagent showing twice in its transcript after the subagent read it
Fixed subagent hand-back messages showing a raw task id instead of the agent's name when the subagent had no registered name
Fixed foreground subagents sometimes missing the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) in sessions that have them enabled
Fixed subagents spawned with worktree isolation loading the project CLAUDE.md and its imports a second time from the worktree copy on their first file read
Fixed Workflow tool subagents being restarted from their original prompt when a connection stalled for a few minutes mid-response
Fixed `/compact`, `/clear`, and `/rewind` typed while viewing a background agent's or teammate's transcript silently acting on the main conversation: a dialog now names the target and asks first
Fixed background jobs showing done while waiting for your approval
Fixed the commit attribution reminder being re-sent inside tool output when a model fallback lasts only one turn
Fixed a click on the space between words of a collapsed row (such as "Thought for 4s") highlighting the row without expanding it in fullscreen mode
Fixed a row with no details, such as an action row with a long name, pushing every other row's details to the right in list screens
Fixed files with very long names not reaching a cloud session when attached to it
Fixed plugin errors for a marketplace Claude Code refuses to load: they now say why and how to fix it instead of "not found"
Fixed `/plugin`'s Discover tab showing a marketplace name unquoted in its "Checking … for new plugins" line when its rows already show that name in quotes
Improved commit guidance: when your project or user skills include one named `verify`, Claude is now told to run it right before committing, except for docs-only and tests-only commits
Improved send now (ctrl+enter) in a subagent's view: it now moves the subagent's running command to the background so your message is read right away
Improved replies from background agents to your messages so they no longer open with a separate recap of what you said

Improved claude.ai artifact link reads: WebFetch now asks the same questions as the Artifact tool's read (no artifact prompt while the session's network access is on, one per artifact while it is off), and an auto-mode yes no longer counts where only you can answer
Improved fetch, skill, file read, sandbox network, Claude in Chrome, workflow script and notebook edit permission prompts to match the look of file edit prompts
Improved Bash, PowerShell and Monitor permission prompts to show the command between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts
Improved list scrollbars in fullscreen mode: in most lists the bar no longer shifts as the "N more" rows come and go, and it now has ↑/↓ arrows you can click or hold to scroll
Improved the external editor (Ctrl+G): editors that take a line number now open on the line your cursor is on in the prompt
Improved slash command suggestion responsiveness while typing when many skills or plugin commands are installed; command descriptions now match by word prefix
Improved the output style picker: it now opens on your current style instead of Default, with each style's description on the line under its name; number keys no longer pick a style
Improved `/hooks`: the closing line of a hook's detail screen now says "this hook" instead of "it"
Improved the model fallback notice and the autocompact-thrashing error to say when a fallback dropped the context window from 1M to 200K tokens
Improved responsiveness of SDK and `-p` sessions when a host re-sends an MCP server enable for a server that is already connected
Improved the protocol page a Claude apps gateway serves at `/protocol`: it now says not to reject unknown input and matches what Claude Code sends today
Changed prompts sent while nothing is running or queued to show in the normal text color right away instead of gray
Changed how failed API requests are retried: one limit now covers a whole model call, so with the default retry settings a failing call sends at most 14 requests

Changed `--bare` to connect only the MCP servers named on the command line, send the model no system reminders, and start no background tasks; under `--bare`, a shell command that reaches its timeout now stops instead of moving to the background
Changed the send-now key (ctrl+enter) to move a skill's own shell command to the background instead of ending it
Changed the WebFetch error for a rate-limited domain safety check to tell Claude not to retry it in a loop
Changed plugin installs to refuse npm sources that are git repositories or folders, and to install plugin dependencies only from registry packages
Changed list screens (`/artifacts`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, `/hooks` and others) to always line up each row's details in one column after the names
Changed the overflow rows of lists to read "↑ N more" / "↓ N more" instead of "N more above" / "N more below"
Changed `/hooks` to open on one list of your configured hooks grouped by event, so viewing a hook takes one Enter instead of three
Changed the theme picker to a scrolling list that fits your terminal instead of pushing the preview off screen; number keys no longer pick a theme
Changed `/exit`'s Remove worktree to run after Claude Code stops the servers and shells it started there, which on Windows could keep the folder from being deleted
Changed the `claude-api` skill's Managed Agents examples to create environments with limited networking
Removed the browser link from `/ultrareview` and `claude ultrareview` output
Windows: Fixed `claude --bg` and the agents view refusing a folder that `claude` already trusts when its trust record was saved with different letter case
[VSCode] Added bookmarks: save Claude's responses and keep them in view in a Bookmarks side panel
[VSCode] Added the questions Claude asks and your answers to the conversation: after you answer a question card, a Questions row shows each question with your picks
[VSCode] Added option previews to question cards in the chat panel: the highlighted choice's mockup or snippet shows beside or under the options
[VSCode] Added rows under a message that open to the terminal output, browser tab, browser instructions and selected code sent with it
[VSCode] Fixed a second copy of a conversation opening in a tab when it was already open in the side bar; the side bar now switches to it
[VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs reporting a failed save, without re-checking, when Claude Code printed more than 1 MB of output
[VSCode] Fixed an endless "Teleporting session…" spinner when the extension stops responding
[VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: it says when a turned-off plugin is still on because of other settings, and explains a plugin folder clash
[VSCode] Changed Stop and Escape to end only the current turn; background agents keep running and can be stopped one by one from the agent map
[VSCode] Changed the "✻ Claude Code" status bar item to show in every window, so you can open Claude when no file is open
[Cloud sessions] Fixed an answered question card or approved tool call getting no reply when the session had gone idle after Claude sent a message
[Cloud sessions] Fixed clearing an organization environment's setup script in admin settings leaving new cloud sessions still running the old script
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the Runner actions menu on the self-hosted environments admin page closing on its own a few seconds after it opened
[Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs whose cloud session never started showing as Succeeded in the Runs pane, the routine's page and the sidebar; they now show as Failed
[Cloud sessions] Fixed clicking an audio or video file in a cloud session's Outputs card opening an empty file search instead of playing the file
[Cloud sessions] Changed a routine's page to read "Due" with the scheduled time, instead of a next run time in the past, when a scheduled run is late and hasn't started
[Claude Tag] Added an Add channel button to Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings, so a limit can be set on any channel, including a private one, from its channel ID or Slack link
[Claude Tag] Fixed memory recall finding nothing in organizations that cannot use the default Sonnet model
[Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack channel losing its Claude settings when an Enterprise Grid admin moves it to another workspace and the first post afterward doesn't mention Claude
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack thread occasionally starting over on a fresh machine, losing work it hadn't pushed, when your reply answered a question it had just asked
[Claude Tag] Fixed public channel names on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings showing as raw Slack IDs in larger organizations
[Claude Tag] Improved the titles of sessions started from Slack as shown on claude.ai: they now read as the words you typed, without Slack user IDs or escape codes

title.zh-TW: 權限提示標明待審總數，指令與工具授權畫面統一
title.en: Permission prompts show total pending count and unify command and tool authorization screens

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 連續執行多項操作而跳出一連串授權詢問時，你現在能一眼掌握還剩幾項要確認。⟦像在銀行櫃檯抽號碼牌辦理業務，螢幕清楚顯示目前叫號與等待人數，各個窗口的申請表單也採用同一套版型。⟧權限提示在多筆請求堆疊時會顯示「2 of 5」等計數，讓你知道整體審核進度。網路擷取、技能、檔案讀取、沙盒網路、Claude in Chrome、工作流程腳本與筆記本編輯的授權面板，外觀都對齊檔案編輯提示。Bash、PowerShell 與 Monitor 指令在詢問時會以虛線框起，指令範圍更清楚。
body.en: When Claude performs multiple operations in a row and triggers a series of authorization requests, you can now see at a glance how many items remain to be confirmed. ⟦Picture taking a number ticket at a bank counter, where the screen clearly shows the current number called and the total waiting count, while application forms across different windows follow the same layout.⟧ Permission prompts now display counts such as "2 of 5" when multiple requests stack up, keeping you informed of the overall review progress. Authorization panels for web fetching, skills, file reading, sandbox network, Claude in Chrome, workflow scripts, and notebook editing all align their appearance with file edit prompts. Bash, PowerShell, and Monitor commands are framed with dashed lines during prompts, making the command boundaries clearer.

items.original:
Added a count such as "2 of 5" to the permission prompt when several permission requests stack up
Improved fetch, skill, file read, sandbox network, Claude in Chrome, workflow script and notebook edit permission prompts to match the look of file edit prompts
Improved Bash, PowerShell and Monitor permission prompts to show the command between dashed lines, matching file edit prompts

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕清單支援滑鼠點選，排版對齊且捲軸增設箭頭
title.en: Fullscreen lists support mouse clicks with aligned layouts and scrollbar arrows

body.zh-TW: 在全螢幕下瀏覽落落長的項目時，清單操作與閱讀變得更加直覺。⟦好比翻閱排版整齊的商品目錄，頁面邊緣附有快速翻頁按鈕，點擊省略項目就能立刻跳轉至該區段。⟧「↑ N more」與「↓ N more」等折疊列現在支援滑鼠懸停、按下狀態與點擊直達列表端點。點擊「Thought for 4s」等收合列的文字間隙時，會正常展開內容而非僅反白。`/artifacts`、`/mcp`、`/skills` 與 `/hooks`（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）等清單中的詳細資訊皆統一對齊於同一欄位；沒有詳細資訊的列，例如名稱很長的操作列，不再把其他列的詳細資訊推向右側。捲軸新增可點擊或按住持續捲動的上下箭頭；在大多數清單中，省略列出現或消失時，捲軸不再跟著位移。
body.en: Browsing lengthy items in fullscreen mode is now more intuitive to navigate and read. ⟦Think of flipping through a neatly formatted catalog with quick-turn buttons on the page margins, where clicking an omitted item immediately jumps to that section.⟧ Collapsed rows like "↑ N more" and "↓ N more" now support mouse hover, pressed states, and clicks that navigate directly to the list ends. Clicking the text gaps of collapsed rows like "Thought for 4s" now properly expands content instead of merely highlighting text. Detailed information across lists such as `/artifacts`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, and `/hooks` is aligned in a single column. Rows without details, such as operation rows with long names, no longer push the details of other rows to the right. Scrollbars gain up and down arrows that can be clicked or held for continuous scrolling. In most lists, the scrollbar no longer shifts when ellipsis rows appear or disappear.

items.original:
Added mouse support for the "N more" rows of lists in fullscreen mode: click one to jump to that end of the list, with hover and pressed states
Fixed a click on the space between words of a collapsed row (such as "Thought for 4s") highlighting the row without expanding it in fullscreen mode
Fixed a row with no details, such as an action row with a long name, pushing every other row's details to the right in list screens
Improved list scrollbars in fullscreen mode: in most lists the bar no longer shifts as the "N more" rows come and go, and it now has ↑/↓ arrows you can click or hold to scroll
Changed list screens (`/artifacts`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, `/hooks` and others) to always line up each row's details in one column after the names
Changed the overflow rows of lists to read "↑ N more" / "↓ N more" instead of "N more above" / "N more below"

title.zh-TW: 憑證過期不再重複跳轉瀏覽器，精確標示登入狀態
title.en: Expired credentials avoid duplicate browser launches and accurately reflect login status

body.zh-TW: 同時開啟多個視窗或編輯器擴充功能時，帳號登入與憑證狀態不再打架。⟦有如社區保全更新通行證，只要在主櫃檯完成登記，各出入口隨即同步放行，不再要求重複出示證件。⟧當 gcpAuthRefresh 或 awsAuthRefresh 憑證過期時，多個行程不會再各自彈出瀏覽器登入頁面。macOS 工作階段在另一個視窗以 `/login` 登入成功後，即使殘留舊版 `~/.claude/.credentials.json` 檔案，也不會誤判為未登入。`claude auth status` 針對主控台儲存的金鑰會如實回報為 `api_key`，VS Code 擴充功能也會正確識別為金鑰工作階段。`/status` 在同時存在 API 金鑰時，會將 Anthropic 設定檔明確標註為未使用。
body.en: When running multiple windows or editor extensions simultaneously, account logins and credential states no longer conflict. ⟦A residential guard updates access passes so that once you register at the main counter, every entrance grants entry in sync without asking for repeated identification.⟧ When gcpAuthRefresh or awsAuthRefresh credentials expire, multiple processes will no longer each open separate browser login pages. After a macOS session logs in successfully via `/login` in another window, it is no longer misidentified as logged out even if a legacy `~/.claude/.credentials.json` file remains. `claude auth status` accurately reports console-stored keys as `api_key`, and the VS Code extension correctly identifies them as key sessions. When an API key is present, `/status` explicitly marks Anthropic profiles as unused.

items.original:
Fixed several Claude Code processes and IDE extensions each opening a login browser when gcpAuthRefresh or awsAuthRefresh credentials expire
Fixed macOS sessions still showing "Not logged in" or "Login expired" after `/login` succeeds in another Claude Code window when a leftover `~/.claude/.credentials.json` exists
Fixed `claude auth status` reporting a Console sign-in's stored API key as `claude.ai`; it now reports `api_key`, and the VS Code extension treats that session as an API key session
Fixed `/status` listing an Anthropic profile beside an API key as if both were in effect; the profile is now marked as not in use

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復不再遺失對話，修復非文字回傳引發的錯誤
title.en: Session resumption preserves conversations and fixes errors from non-text returns

body.zh-TW: 遇到終端機當機或非預期中斷時，重新接關不再面臨對話進度遺失的窘境。⟦正如遊戲中途斷線後重新連線，先前的對話紀錄連同平行工具呼叫後的內容都能找回，檔名過長的附加道具也能順利載入。⟧使用 `claude --resume` 或 `--continue` 恢復先前崩潰的工作階段（session）時，不會再遺失平行工具呼叫後的對話紀錄。工具或掛鉤回傳物件、數字或布林值等非純文字內容時，不再引發 API 400 錯誤；恢復的工作階段也適用。歷史紀錄極為龐大的雲端工作階段，容器不會在載入對話紀錄時提前停止而無法喚醒。附加檔名超長的檔案到雲端工作階段時，也能正常送達。
body.en: When encountering terminal crashes or unexpected interruptions, resuming work no longer risks losing conversation progress. ⟦Imagine reconnecting after disconnecting mid-game, where past chat logs alongside content after parallel tool calls are fully restored, and attached items with extra-long filenames load smoothly.⟧ Resuming a previously crashed session with `claude --resume` or `--continue` will no longer lose conversation history following parallel tool calls. Non-text returns from tools or hooks—such as objects, numbers, or booleans—no longer trigger API 400 errors, which also applies to resumed sessions. For cloud sessions with massive histories, containers no longer terminate prematurely during transcript loading and fail to wake. Files with extremely long filenames attached to cloud sessions can now also be delivered properly.

items.original:
Fixed `claude --resume` and `--continue` sometimes losing every turn after a batch of parallel tool calls when the earlier session crashed or was killed
Fixed API 400 errors after a tool or hook returned an object, number or boolean instead of text, including in resumed sessions
Fixed cloud sessions with very large histories never waking up because the container was stopped while the transcript was still loading
Fixed files with very long names not reaching a cloud session when attached to it

title.zh-TW: 模型不可用時自動切換同級備援，重試次數改採單一上限
title.en: Model unavailability triggers same-tier fallback with a unified retry limit

body.zh-TW: 當 API 拒絕預設模型或模型別名對應的模型時，你不必每輪都手動換模型。⟦宛若主發電機跳電時切換至備用機組，儀表板會亮燈提示輸出功率變化，避免反覆重新發動造成電力耗盡。⟧Claude Code 只重試一次，改用同等級的前一版模型備援（fallback）。備援模型與 `--fallback-model` 重試若無法高速運行，會以標準速度執行，並只在互動式工作階段顯示一次通知。若備援使上下文視窗從 1M 縮減至 200K token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），備援通知與自動壓縮反覆觸發時的錯誤訊息都會標明容量變化。失敗的 API 請求改以單次模型呼叫為單位計算重試上限，預設設定下最多發送 14 次請求。僅持續一輪的備援也不會重複發送 Git 提交註記提醒。
body.en: When an API rejects the default model or the model mapped by an alias, you no longer need to switch models manually every turn. ⟦A backup generator kicks in when the main power trips, while the dashboard lights up to show output changes and prevent repeated restarts from draining battery reserves.⟧ Claude Code retries only once, falling back to an earlier model of the same tier. If the fallback model and `--fallback-model` retries cannot run at high speed, they execute at standard speed and display a notification only once in interactive sessions. If a fallback reduces the context window from 1M to 200K tokens, both the fallback notification and error messages from repeated auto-compaction will state the capacity change. Failed API requests now calculate their retry limit per individual model call, sending at most 14 requests under default settings. Single-turn fallbacks will also not send duplicate Git commit note reminders.

items.original:
Fixed every turn failing when the Anthropic API refuses the model your default or a model alias resolves to: Claude Code now retries once on the previous model of the same tier
Fixed refusal and `--fallback-model` retries failing when the fallback model can't run fast; they now run at standard speed, with a one-time notice in interactive sessions
Fixed the commit attribution reminder being re-sent inside tool output when a model fallback lasts only one turn
Improved the model fallback notice and the autocompact-thrashing error to say when a fallback dropped the context window from 1M to 200K tokens
Changed how failed API requests are retried: one limit now covers a whole model call, so with the default retry settings a failing call sends at most 14 requests

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控配合組織政策自動斷線，排隊訊息於重啟後接續處理
title.en: Remote Control disconnects on organization policy and queued messages resume on restart

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端操控（Remote Control）跨裝置連線時，連線狀態與訊息傳遞更加可靠。⟦如同對講機在總台關閉頻道時自動切斷並發出嗶聲，離線前收到的留言則妥善保存在收件匣等待下次開機。⟧當組織政策停用遠端操控時，包含 `claude remote-control` 在內的工作階段會主動中斷連線並顯示通知。透過遠端連線傳送的附加檔案若未成功送達，Claude 會獲知，且檔案最後一次下載嘗試有時只剩 10 秒的問題已修好。在程式即將退出時抵達的訊息不會被誤標為已送達，而是保留在佇列中供下次啟動時回覆。
body.en: Connecting across devices via Remote Control is now more dependable for connection states and message delivery. ⟦Consider a walkie-talkie that beeps and cuts off when the base station closes the channel, while messages received before going offline remain saved in an inbox for the next startup.⟧ When an organization policy disables Remote Control, sessions including `claude remote-control` proactively disconnect and display a notification. Claude is informed if attached files sent over remote connections fail to deliver, and an issue where the final download attempt sometimes had only 10 seconds remaining is resolved. Messages arriving right as the program exits are no longer mislabeled as delivered, remaining in the queue to be answered on the next run.

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control sessions (including `claude remote-control`) staying connected after your organization's policy turns Remote Control off; they now disconnect with a notice
Fixed Claude not being told when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control did not arrive, and a file sometimes getting only 10 seconds for its last download try
Fixed a Remote Control message that arrived while Claude Code was exiting being marked delivered and then never answered; it now stays queued for the session's next run

title.zh-TW: 隱藏錯誤日誌中的敏感金鑰，修正回報檔案的格式
title.en: Sensitive keys masked in error logs and report file formats fixed

body.zh-TW: 在匯出對話紀錄或查看錯誤訊息時，機密資訊遮蔽變得更加滴水不漏。⟦猶如保密公文銷毀機處理機密文件，不管是夾帶看不見的隱形墨水還是特殊符號密碼，都能完整抹除而不損及文件結構。⟧MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）錯誤訊息在 Bearer 或 Basic 位於鍵名前方時，不會再暴露憑證內容。百分比編碼的 Bearer token（授權令牌）不再只有部分被遮蔽。鍵名含有零寬空格等不可見字元的機密設定，在日誌與對話紀錄中會確實隱藏。URL 密碼若包含引號、括號、`&` 或第二個 `@` 等標點，在日誌與對話紀錄中不會再殘留部分字元。若密碼在 ssh 網址中跨過 `/`，延伸至 `[::1]` 這類方括號主機，也會完整遮蔽。`/feedback` 儲存的壓縮檔在脫敏後，工作階段對話紀錄不再出現格式錯誤的 JSON 行。
body.en: When exporting transcripts or inspecting error messages, secret redaction is now far more airtight. ⟦A shredder sanitizes classified paperwork by completely stripping away invisible ink and symbolic passwords without corrupting the document structure.⟧ MCP error messages no longer expose credentials when Bearer or Basic precedes key names. Percent-encoded Bearer tokens are no longer only partially redacted. Secret settings with key names containing invisible characters like zero-width spaces are properly hidden in logs and transcripts. When URL passwords contain punctuation such as quotes, parentheses, `&`, or a second `@`, no partial characters linger in logs and transcripts. Passwords extending across `/` to bracketed hosts like `[::1]` in ssh URLs are also fully redacted. Responding to `/feedback`, redacted archives no longer produce malformed JSON lines in session transcripts.

items.original:
Fixed MCP error messages showing a credential's value when "Bearer" or "Basic" came before its key name
Fixed percent-encoded Bearer tokens being only partly masked in error messages
Fixed redacted logs and transcripts showing a secret whose key name has an invisible character inside, such as a zero-width space
Fixed logs and transcripts showing part of a URL password that contains punctuation such as `)`, quotes, `]`, `&` or a second `@`, or that runs past a `/` to a bracketed host such as `[::1]` in an ssh URL
Fixed the session transcript in the zip that `/feedback` saves to disk containing invalid JSON lines after secret redaction

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器重新驗證不再重複提醒，正常記錄工具用量
title.en: MCP server re-authentication avoids duplicate prompts and logs tool usage properly

body.zh-TW: 串接 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，連線握手與登入授權流程更為穩定。⟦跟外接擴充座重新開機後恢復連線一樣，通訊記錄如實登記各埠口用量，也不再反覆顯示授權提醒。⟧無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗的執行方式）的工作階段重新驗證成功後，不再重複顯示提醒；這項修復適用於已啟用探索快取的情況。快取是把查過的結果暫存起來直接用。當伺服器停止舊版握手協定時，MCP 連接器不會再發生長達一天找不到工具的情況。重複發送的登入請求不會覆蓋尚未完成的驗證連結。MCP 伺服器仍在連線中或剛連上時，工具呼叫都會正確計入 `/usage`。主機重複啟用已連線伺服器時，SDK（供程式串接的開發工具包）與 `-p` 模式反應更快。
body.en: Connecting to MCP servers now offers more stable connection handshakes and login authorization workflows. ⟦Like an external docking station reconnecting after a reboot, communication logs record usage per port without repeatedly prompting for authorization.⟧ Headless sessions no longer display redundant prompts after successful re-authentication, a fix that applies when discovery caching is enabled. When servers deprecate legacy handshake protocols, MCP connectors will no longer lose track of tools for up to a day. Duplicate login requests will not overwrite pending verification links. Tool calls are accurately counted in `/usage` while MCP servers are connecting or just connected. When a host re-enables an already connected server, both the SDK and `-p` mode respond faster.

items.original:
Fixed headless sessions repeating the "MCP servers require authentication" reminder after a successful re-authentication when the MCP discovery cache is enabled
Fixed MCP connectors listing no tools for up to a day after their server dropped the older MCP handshake
Fixed a repeat MCP sign-in request from Claude replacing the pending sign-in link, which could stop that link from working
Fixed `/usage` not crediting an MCP server for a tool call made while that server was still connecting or had only just connected, such as right after a restart
Improved responsiveness of SDK and `-p` sessions when a host re-sends an MCP server enable for a server that is already connected

title.zh-TW: 與子代理溝通更即時，操作背景對話紀錄前會先確認目標
title.en: Subagent communication is more responsive and background transcript actions require confirmation

body.zh-TW: 派遣子代理在背景執行繁重任務時，即時發送訊息與檢視進度的體驗更加順暢。⟦類似向後台工作人員遞送緊急紙條，對方會立刻把手邊雜務轉入後台並讀取指示，回報時也省去冗長重複的複述。⟧在子代理視窗按下立即發送快捷鍵（Ctrl+Enter）時，會將子代理目前執行的指令移至背景，以便立刻讀取你的輸入。輸入給子代理的訊息在被讀取後，對話紀錄中不會再重複出現兩次。背景代理人回覆時，開頭不再多餘複述你剛剛說過的話。未註冊名稱的子代理交回工作時，會顯示代理人代稱而非原始任務識別碼。在檢視背景代理人或隊友的對話紀錄時輸入 `/compact`、`/clear` 或 `/rewind`，系統會跳出對話框標明目標並詢問確認，防止誤改主對話。
body.en: Dispatching subagents to handle heavy background tasks now provides a smoother experience when sending immediate messages and tracking progress. ⟦Much like passing an urgent note to backstage staff, the recipient immediately moves background chores aside to read instructions and omits repetitive recaps when reporting back.⟧ Pressing the immediate send shortcut (Ctrl+Enter) in a subagent window moves the subagent's running command to the background to read your input right away. Messages typed to subagents no longer appear twice in the transcript after being read. When background agents reply, they no longer needlessly repeat what you just said. Subagents without registered names display an agent alias instead of raw task IDs when yielding work. Typing `/compact`, `/clear`, or `/rewind` while viewing a background agent or teammate transcript opens a dialog naming the target to confirm, preventing accidental modifications to the main conversation.

items.original:
Fixed a message typed into a running subagent showing twice in its transcript after the subagent read it
Fixed subagent hand-back messages showing a raw task id instead of the agent's name when the subagent had no registered name
Fixed `/compact`, `/clear`, and `/rewind` typed while viewing a background agent's or teammate's transcript silently acting on the main conversation: a dialog now names the target and asks first
Improved send now (ctrl+enter) in a subagent's view: it now moves the subagent's running command to the background so your message is read right away
Improved replies from background agents to your messages so they no longer open with a separate recap of what you said

title.zh-TW: 修復子代理工具遺失與重複載入，精確反映審批狀態
title.en: Subagent tool loss and duplicate loading fixed while approval statuses reflect accurately

body.zh-TW: 當你啟動子代理處理專案時，背景環境的工具配置與生命週期更加健全。⟦彷彿分派助手至獨立工作區施工，工具箱裡的清單追蹤器具一應俱全，也不會把早已讀過的施工指南重複拆封。⟧在已啟用任務追蹤的工作階段中，前景子代理不會再偶爾遺失 TaskCreate、TaskGet 或 TodoWrite 等工具。透過工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）隔離建立的子代理，在首次讀取檔案時不會從副本重複載入專案的 CLAUDE.md 及其匯入設定。工作流程工具子代理在回應中途遇到幾分鐘的連線停頓時，不會再從初始提示詞被重頭重啟。等待使用者核准的背景工作，在狀態畫面上不再被錯誤標記為已完成。
body.en: Launching subagents to work on projects now offers a sturdier tool configuration and lifecycle in background environments. ⟦Assigning an assistant to an isolated work area ensures every checklist tracking tool is on hand without repeatedly unboxing already reviewed guidelines.⟧ In sessions with task tracking enabled, foreground subagents will no longer occasionally lose tools like TaskCreate, TaskGet, or TodoWrite. Subagents created with worktree isolation will not redundantly reload the project's CLAUDE.md and imported settings from the copy on the first file read. Workflow tool subagents experiencing a multi-minute stall mid-response will no longer restart from scratch using the initial prompt. Background tasks awaiting user approval are no longer falsely marked as completed on status screens.

items.original:
Fixed foreground subagents sometimes missing the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) in sessions that have them enabled
Fixed subagents spawned with worktree isolation loading the project CLAUDE.md and its imports a second time from the worktree copy on their first file read
Fixed Workflow tool subagents being restarted from their original prompt when a connection stalled for a few minutes mid-response
Fixed background jobs showing done while waiting for your approval

title.zh-TW: 外掛安裝限制套件來源，清楚說明市集載入錯誤
title.en: Plugin Installation Restricts Package Sources and Clarifies Marketplace Loading Errors

body.zh-TW: 管理與安裝外掛擴充時，套件相依性安全與錯誤排查資訊都更加清楚。⟦就像從套件註冊表領取安裝材料，安裝時會拒絕從 Git 儲存庫或本地資料夾取得的套件；遇上無法載入的市集，也會說明原因與排解方式。⟧外掛安裝現在會拒絕來自 Git 儲存庫或本地資料夾的 npm 來源，且僅允許從套件註冊表（registry package）安裝相依套件。當系統拒絕載入特定外掛市集時，錯誤訊息會明確說明原因與修復步驟，不再僅顯示「not found」。在 `/plugin` 的 Discover 頁面中，市集名稱的引號顯示格式保持一致。伺服器發生短暫異常時，在 claude.ai 上啟用的外掛不會再於當前工作階段中突然消失。
body.en: When managing and installing plugin extensions, package dependency security and troubleshooting information are much clearer. ⟦Just as procurement requires sourcing materials only from an official registry while rejecting goods from Git repositories or local folders, the system blocks unsafe packages and clarifies troubleshooting steps when a marketplace fails to load.⟧ Plugin installation now rejects npm sources from Git repositories or local folders, allowing dependencies to be installed only from registry packages. When the system rejects loading a specific plugin marketplace, error messages explicitly explain the cause and remediation steps instead of merely showing "not found". On the `/plugin` Discover page, quotation marks around marketplace names maintain consistent formatting. Plugins enabled on claude.ai no longer abruptly disappear during the active session when brief server hiccups occur.

items.original:
Fixed plugins enabled on claude.ai occasionally going missing from Claude Code for a session after a transient server error
Fixed plugin errors for a marketplace Claude Code refuses to load: they now say why and how to fix it instead of "not found"
Fixed `/plugin`'s Discover tab showing a marketplace name unquoted in its "Checking … for new plugins" line when its rows already show that name in quotes
Changed plugin installs to refuse npm sources that are git repositories or folders, and to install plugin dependencies only from registry packages

title.zh-TW: 外部編輯器精準定位游標行，斜線指令與設定選單更流暢
title.en: External Editor Precision Line Navigation and Smoother Slash Commands and Settings Menus

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中撰寫長提示詞或調整外觀設定時，各項互動細節更加得心應手。⟦切換專業文字編輯器時游標停在同一行，快捷選單依據關鍵字快速過濾，外觀與樣式也能在清單內自如捲動挑選。⟧使用外部編輯器（Ctrl+G）時，支援行號參數的編輯器會直接開啟在游標所在的提示詞行數。安裝大量技能或外掛時，斜線指令的即時自動補齊更靈敏，說明文字改採單字前綴匹配。輸出風格選擇器會直接定位在目前使用的樣式，並在名稱下方顯示詳細說明；數字鍵不再選取輸出風格。主題選擇器改為符合終端機高度的可捲動清單，預覽畫面不再被推出螢幕外；數字鍵也不再選取主題。`/hooks`（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在依事件分組顯示於單一清單，只要按一次 Enter 即可檢視細節。詳細畫面的結尾也改說「this hook」，不再說「it」。
body.en: Writing long prompts or tweaking appearance settings in the terminal now feels significantly more responsive. ⟦Opening a dedicated editor places the cursor on the exact line, quick menus filter instantly by keyword, and visual styles scroll smoothly within a tidy list.⟧ When using an external editor (Ctrl+G), editors supporting line number arguments open directly at the prompt line where your cursor was positioned. When many skills or plugins are installed, slash command autocomplete is more responsive, matching description text by word prefix. The output style picker now focuses directly on the active style with detailed descriptions shown beneath each name; numeric keys no longer select output styles. The theme picker is now a scrollable list sized to terminal height so previews are not pushed off-screen, and numeric keys no longer select themes. `/hooks` is now grouped by event in a single list, allowing you to inspect details with a single Enter keystroke. The detailed view ending now says "this hook" instead of "it".

items.original:
Improved the external editor (Ctrl+G): editors that take a line number now open on the line your cursor is on in the prompt
Improved slash command suggestion responsiveness while typing when many skills or plugin commands are installed; command descriptions now match by word prefix
Improved the output style picker: it now opens on your current style instead of Default, with each style's description on the line under its name; number keys no longer pick a style
Improved `/hooks`: the closing line of a hook's detail screen now says "this hook" instead of "it"
Changed `/hooks` to open on one list of your configured hooks grouped by event, so viewing a hook takes one Enter instead of three
Changed the theme picker to a scrolling list that fits your terminal instead of pushing the preview off screen; number keys no longer pick a theme

title.zh-TW: 極簡模式限制連線與背景任務，提交前提示驗證技能
title.en: Bare Mode Limits Connections and Background Tasks while Guiding Skill Verification Before Commit

body.zh-TW: 在乾淨環境執行任務或把關品質時，指令列與背景流程配合得更緊密。⟦工廠切換至純手動模式會關閉背景排程，出貨前提醒品管，收工先熄火才拆機具。⟧專案或個人技能若有 `verify` 技能，除純改文件或測試外，Claude 提交前會收到先執行它的指引。啟用 `--bare` 旗標時僅連線指定的 MCP 伺服器、不發系統提醒且不開背景工作；逾時 Shell 指令直接停止而非轉入背景。閒置時發送提示詞，文字立即顯示為標準顏色而非灰色。按下立即發送鍵時，技能自帶的 Shell 指令會轉入背景而非被終止。`/exit` 移除工作樹時會先停止 Claude Code 在該工作樹啟動的伺服器與 Shell，避免 Windows 因檔案佔用無法刪除資料夾。`/ultrareview` 與 `claude ultrareview` 輸出不再附瀏覽器連結。
body.en: Running tasks or enforcing quality in clean environments now integrates command-line tools and background workflows much tighter. ⟦A factory switching to manual mode disables background schedules, prompts quality control before shipping, and turns off engines before dismantling machinery.⟧ If a project or personal skill includes a `verify` skill, Claude is prompted to run it before committing changes, except for pure documentation or test edits. Enabling the `--bare` flag connects only to specified MCP servers, sends the model no system reminders, and skips launching background tasks; timed-out shell commands stop immediately instead of moving to the background. Submitting prompts while idle instantly displays text in standard coloring instead of gray. Pressing the instant-send key sends skill-invoked shell commands to the background rather than terminating them. Removing a worktree via `/exit` now terminates servers and shells started by Claude Code inside that worktree first, preventing Windows folder deletion failures caused by locked files. Output from `/ultrareview` and `claude ultrareview` no longer includes browser links.

items.original:
Improved commit guidance: when your project or user skills include one named `verify`, Claude is now told to run it right before committing, except for docs-only and tests-only commits
Changed prompts sent while nothing is running or queued to show in the normal text color right away instead of gray
Changed `--bare` to connect only the MCP servers named on the command line, send the model no system reminders, and start no background tasks; under `--bare`, a shell command that reaches its timeout now stops instead of moving to the background
Changed the send-now key (ctrl+enter) to move a skill's own shell command to the background instead of ending it
Changed `/exit`'s Remove worktree to run after Claude Code stops the servers and shells it started there, which on Windows could keep the folder from being deleted
Removed the browser link from `/ultrareview` and `claude ultrareview` output

title.zh-TW: 統一成品讀取與網路授權流程，精準計算閘道快取費用
title.en: Unified Artifact Reading and Web Permissions with Precise Gateway Cache Billing

body.zh-TW: 讀取 claude.ai 成品或抓取網路資料時，權限詢問與計費更為準確。⟦比照郵件逐件通關，連線受阻時不反覆敲門，計費磅秤如實按存放時效結算。⟧WebFetch 讀取 claude.ai 成品連結時比照成品工具：工作階段開啟網路時不詢問，關閉時各問一次；自動模式不能代答僅你能確認的問題。網域安全檢查若遇速率限制，錯誤訊息會提醒 Claude 不要反覆重試。Claude apps 閘道原本把 1 小時提示快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）誤算為 5 分鐘費率，現已修正。伺服器端工具串流也計入後續呼叫的輸入 token（計量文字的單位）。閘道 `/protocol` 頁面已對齊最新規格，並註明不應拒絕未知輸入。`claude-api` 技能的 Managed Agents 範例改用受限網路環境。
body.en: Reading claude.ai artifacts or fetching web data now features more accurate permission prompts and billing calculations. ⟦Mail clears customs item by item, blocked connections avoid knocking repeatedly, and billing scales settle charges strictly by storage duration.⟧ When WebFetch reads claude.ai artifact links, it follows artifact tool rules: no prompts appear when session web access is enabled, and one prompt per artifact is shown when disabled; auto-mode cannot answer prompts that require your direct confirmation. When domain safety checks hit rate limits, error messages advise Claude against repeated retries. The Claude apps gateway previously miscalculated 1-hour prompt caching at the 5-minute rate, which is now fixed. Server-side tool streaming now counts toward input tokens for subsequent calls. The gateway `/protocol` page now aligns with the latest specification and notes that unknown inputs should not be rejected. The Managed Agents example in the `claude-api` skill now uses a restricted network environment.

items.original:
Fixed the Claude apps gateway's spend meter pricing 1-hour prompt cache writes at the cheaper 5-minute rate, and counting only the first model call's input tokens on streamed turns that run a server-side tool such as web search
Improved claude.ai artifact link reads: WebFetch now asks the same questions as the Artifact tool's read (no artifact prompt while the session's network access is on, one per artifact while it is off), and an auto-mode yes no longer counts where only you can answer
Improved the protocol page a Claude apps gateway serves at `/protocol`: it now says not to reject unknown input and matches what Claude Code sends today
Changed the WebFetch error for a rate-limited domain safety check to tell Claude not to retry it in a loop
Changed the `claude-api` skill's Managed Agents examples to create environments with limited networking

title.zh-TW: Windows 解決資料夾信任大小寫不一致的判定問題
title.en: Windows Resolves Case Sensitivity Mismatches in Folder Trust Checks

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上使用背景代理人時，不再因為資料夾路徑大小寫不同而遭拒絕存取。⟦就像門禁系統比對訪客名單，不論英文名字寫成大寫還是小寫，都能認出是同一位獲准進入的住戶，不再因大小寫不一致而擋在門外。⟧以前在 Windows 環境下，若資料夾信任紀錄儲存時使用了不同的大小寫形式，執行 `claude --bg` 或開啟代理人檢視畫面時，會被誤判為未受信任的資料夾而遭拒絕；現在已修復路徑判定邏輯，能正確識別既有的信任狀態並順利運作。
body.en: Running background agents on Windows no longer encounters access denials caused by folder path casing differences. ⟦An access control system checks visitor logs, recognizing an approved resident whether their name is written in uppercase or lowercase and preventing false lockouts caused by casing mismatches.⟧ Previously on Windows, if stored folder trust records used inconsistent casing, running `claude --bg` or opening agent views would misclassify the directory as untrusted and deny access; path evaluation logic is now fixed to correctly recognize existing trust states.

items.original: Windows: Fixed `claude --bg` and the agents view refusing a folder that `claude` already trusts when its trust record was saved with different letter case

title.zh-TW: VS Code 新增回覆書籤與問題預覽，整合終端機與選取程式碼
title.en: VS Code Adds Response Bookmarks, Question Previews, and Integrated Context Drawers

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 編輯器中使用 Claude 時，對話紀錄的整理與上下文檢視變得更加方便。⟦比照在筆記側邊貼上索引標籤方便隨時翻閱，問卷選項旁直接附上示意圖，訊息下方也能隨時展開參考資料。⟧書籤功能讓你能將 Claude 的精彩回覆保存至側邊的 Bookmarks 面板，隨時固定檢視。在聊天面板回答問題卡片時，目前反白選項的畫面示意圖或程式碼片段，會顯示在選項旁或下方。回答完問題卡片後，對話中會新增 Questions 欄位完整保留問題與你的選擇紀錄。訊息下方新增專屬列，可直接點擊展開隨訊息一同傳送的終端機輸出、瀏覽器分頁、瀏覽器操作指令及選取的程式碼。
body.en: Organizing chat history and inspecting context in the VS Code editor is now significantly more convenient. ⟦Sticky index tabs line notebook margins for quick reference, survey choices show visual diagrams alongside options, and expandable reference drawers sit right beneath messages.⟧ The bookmark feature lets you save standout Claude responses to the sidebar Bookmarks panel for pinned viewing at any time. When answering question cards in the chat panel, screenshots or code snippets for the currently highlighted option appear beside or beneath that choice. Once answered, a Questions section is appended to the conversation to preserve the prompt and your selection history. A dedicated bar beneath messages lets you click to expand attached terminal outputs, browser tabs, browser actions, and selected code.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added bookmarks: save Claude's responses and keep them in view in a Bookmarks side panel
[VSCode] Added the questions Claude asks and your answers to the conversation: after you answer a question card, a Questions row shows each question with your picks
[VSCode] Added option previews to question cards in the chat panel: the highlighted choice's mockup or snippet shows beside or under the options
[VSCode] Added rows under a message that open to the terminal output, browser tab, browser instructions and selected code sent with it

title.zh-TW: VS Code 狀態列常駐所有視窗，停止鍵僅結束當前輪次
title.en: VS Code Status Bar Appears Across All Windows and Stop Action Halts Only Active Turn

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 進行多工開發時，擴充功能的控制按鈕與分頁管理更符合操作直覺。⟦就像辦公軟體的快捷狀態列常駐在所有視窗底部，按下暫停鍵只會停止手邊這份文件的列印，不影響後台正在跑的批次報表。⟧「✻ Claude Code」狀態列（status bar）圖示現在會在所有視窗顯示，即使未開啟任何檔案也能直接開啟。按下 Stop 按鈕或 Escape 鍵改為僅結束當前輪次的生成，背景代理人會繼續運行，且可於代理人地圖中單獨停止。當對話已在側邊欄開啟時，點選不會再於編輯區重複開啟同一份對話分頁，而是直接切換過去。設定對話框在輸出超過 1 MB 時不再未經確認就誤報儲存失敗。擴充功能無回應時卡在「Teleporting session…」的旋轉圖示問題已獲得修復。外掛管理視窗會說明停用的外掛為何仍因其他設定而啟用，也會說明外掛資料夾衝突。
body.en: Multitasking in VS Code now offers more intuitive extension controls and tab management. ⟦An office suite keeps a status bar across every open window, and pressing pause halts printing for only the active document without interrupting background batch reports.⟧ The "✻ Claude Code" status bar icon now displays across all windows, allowing you to open the interface even without any active files. Pressing the Stop button or Escape key now cancels only the active generation turn; background agents continue running and can be stopped individually from the agent map. When a session is already open in the sidebar, clicking it switches to the conversation in the sidebar instead of opening a duplicate tab in the editor area. Settings dialogs no longer falsely report save failures without confirmation when output exceeds 1 MB. An issue where unresponsive extensions remained stuck on a spinning "Teleporting session…" prompt is resolved. The plugin management view now clarifies why disabled plugins remain active due to other settings and explains plugin folder conflicts.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a second copy of a conversation opening in a tab when it was already open in the side bar; the side bar now switches to it
[VSCode] Fixed settings dialogs reporting a failed save, without re-checking, when Claude Code printed more than 1 MB of output
[VSCode] Fixed an endless "Teleporting session…" spinner when the extension stops responding
[VSCode] Improved the Manage plugins dialog: it says when a turned-off plugin is still on because of other settings, and explains a plugin folder clash
[VSCode] Changed Stop and Escape to end only the current turn; background agents keep running and can be stopped one by one from the agent map
[VSCode] Changed the "✻ Claude Code" status bar item to show in every window, so you can open Claude when no file is open

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段精準反映排程與執行狀態，修復音訊預覽與授權卡片
title.en: Cloud Sessions Accurately Reflect Schedule and Run States with Audio Preview and Card Fixes

body.zh-TW: 在雲端環境中運行自動化例行排程或長時間任務時，狀態看板與操作介面更加精確。⟦正如航班資訊看板將誤點未起飛的班次如實標記為待出發或取消，不再將未執行的航程誤判為順利抵達。⟧當例行排程逾期尚未啟動時，頁面會顯示「Due」與預定時間，不再顯示過期的下次執行時間；若工作階段根本未啟動，狀態會如實標示為 Failed。工作階段（session）在 Claude 送出訊息轉為閒置後，使用者回覆問題卡片或核准工具呼叫能正常觸發後續回應。管理員設定中清除組織環境的建置指令稿後，新建立的雲端工作階段不會再沿用舊指令稿。點擊 Outputs 卡片中的音訊或影片檔案時，會直接進行播放而非跳出空白檔案搜尋。自託管環境管理頁面上的 Runner 選單不再於開啟數秒後自動關閉。
body.en: Running automated schedules or long-running tasks in cloud environments now features more accurate dashboards and controls. ⟦A flight departures board marks delayed, unstarted flights as pending or cancelled instead of mislabeling unexecuted trips as arrived on time.⟧ When a scheduled routine is overdue to run, the page displays "Due" with its scheduled time rather than an outdated next run time; if a session fails to start altogether, its status is accurately marked as Failed. After Claude sends a message and goes idle, replying to a question card or approving a tool call reliably triggers subsequent responses. Clearing the organization environment build script in admin settings ensures newly created cloud sessions no longer inherit obsolete scripts. Clicking audio or video files inside the Outputs card now plays media directly rather than opening an empty file search. The runner menu on the self-hosted management page no longer closes automatically seconds after opening.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Fixed an answered question card or approved tool call getting no reply when the session had gone idle after Claude sent a message
[Cloud sessions] Fixed clearing an organization environment's setup script in admin settings leaving new cloud sessions still running the old script
[Cloud sessions] Fixed the Runner actions menu on the self-hosted environments admin page closing on its own a few seconds after it opened
[Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs whose cloud session never started showing as Succeeded in the Runs pane, the routine's page and the sidebar; they now show as Failed
[Cloud sessions] Fixed clicking an audio or video file in a cloud session's Outputs card opening an empty file search instead of playing the file
[Cloud sessions] Changed a routine's page to read "Due" with the scheduled time, instead of a next run time in the past, when a scheduled run is late and hasn't started

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 支援個別頻道花費上限，修復 Slack 記憶讀取與對話標題
title.en: Claude Tag Supports Per-Channel Spending Limits with Fixes for Slack Memory and Session Titles

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 標記 Claude 協作時，管理設定與對話延續性更加健全。⟦替頻道設零用金上限，搬遷工作區保留設定，答題時也不會因換新機器弄丟進度。⟧管理員可在花費上限頁點選「Add channel」，以頻道 ID 或 Slack 連結為包含私人頻道的任何頻道設定額度（quota）。無法使用預設 Sonnet 模型的組織，現在也能正常讀取長期記憶。企業網格管理員將頻道移到其他工作區後，即使首則貼文沒提到 Claude，頻道設定也不會遺失。在討論串回覆 Claude 剛問的問題時，不再偶爾重開新機器而遺失未推送進度。大型組織的花費上限頁會正常顯示公開頻道名稱而非原始代碼；Slack 發起的工作階段在 claude.ai 上的標題也改為純文字，去除跳脫字元與使用者識別碼。
body.en: Collaborating with Claude via tags in Slack features sounder administrative controls and conversation continuity. ⟦Setting spending limits on departmental accounts preserves channel preferences across workspace moves, ensuring answering prompts never loses unpushed progress from unexpected machine resets.⟧ Admins can click "Add channel" on the spend limits page to assign quotas by channel ID or Slack link for any channel, including private channels. Organizations without access to the default Sonnet model can now retrieve long-term memory normally. When Enterprise Grid admins move channels between workspaces, channel settings remain intact even if the initial post does not mention Claude. Responding to Claude's questions in a thread no longer occasionally spawns a new machine and loses unpushed progress. Spend limit pages for large organizations properly display public channel names instead of raw IDs; session titles initiated from Slack on claude.ai are converted to plain text, stripping escape characters and user IDs.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added an Add channel button to Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings, so a limit can be set on any channel, including a private one, from its channel ID or Slack link
[Claude Tag] Fixed memory recall finding nothing in organizations that cannot use the default Sonnet model
[Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack channel losing its Claude settings when an Enterprise Grid admin moves it to another workspace and the first post afterward doesn't mention Claude
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a Slack thread occasionally starting over on a fresh machine, losing work it hadn't pushed, when your reply answered a question it had just asked
[Claude Tag] Fixed public channel names on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings showing as raw Slack IDs in larger organizations
[Claude Tag] Improved the titles of sessions started from Slack as shown on claude.ai: they now read as the words you typed, without Slack user IDs or escape codes

entries: Eligible local sessions signed in with ChatGPT can now show optional reminders to complete account security setup. (#49744)

title.zh-TW: 使用 ChatGPT 登入本機時，可收到帳號安全設定提醒
title.en: Receive Account Security Reminders When Logging In with ChatGPT Locally

body.zh-TW: 如果你平常習慣在終端機裡用 ChatGPT 帳號登入來協助寫程式，遇到帳號防護尚未齊全時，畫面會適時跳出提示。在符合條件的本機工作階段（session，在電腦端與 AI 連線互動的執行過程）中，現在能主動顯示選用的提醒訊息，引導你前往完成帳號安全設定。⟦像大樓的門禁管理處，以前只要出示識別證就直接放行，現在若發現你的證件還沒補齊聯絡資料，會在通過閘門時順手遞上一張便條提醒你抽空登記。⟧ 這項提示屬於非強制的選用通知，讓你在本機使用工具的同時，也能隨時注意到自己帳號的防護狀態，依提示補齊安全設定。
body.en: If you typically log in with your ChatGPT account in the terminal for coding assistance, the screen now displays a timely prompt when your account protection is not fully configured. In eligible local sessions, optional reminder messages can now appear proactively to guide you through completing your account security setup. ⟦Picture a building security desk that previously let you straight through whenever you showed your badge, but now hands you a note at the gate if it spots missing contact details, reminding you to register when you have time.⟧ This prompt is a non-mandatory optional notice, allowing you to stay aware of your account protection status while using tools locally and complete security settings as prompted.

items.original: Eligible local sessions signed in with ChatGPT can now show optional reminders to complete account security setup. (#49744)

entries: Added the `Queued Messages` option to `/config`: keep the default `Queue` to hold follow-up messages until the current turn ends, or choose `Send Immediately` to interrupt the agent with them; it can also be set with `"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"` in `settings.json`, which was previously ignored

Improved `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager, such as most containers: instead of failing, it now starts the daemon as a background process and warns that it will not restart after a crash or start at boot; `remote-control status` shows its PID and `remote-control stop` shuts it down
Improved loading long conversations: resuming a conversation with thousands of steps is noticeably faster because the CLI no longer scans every step up front

Improved automatically generated conversation titles to take images and files attached to your first message into account, so screenshot- or file-driven requests get specific titles and messages with only attachments get a title too
Improved the sign-in error shown to accounts blocked for a Terms of Service violation, which now includes a link to submit an appeal

Changed `--json-schema` to reject plain text, bare type names such as `string`, and missing schema files instead of silently treating them as a string schema; these inputs, and any schema whose root is not `"type": "object"`, now fail at startup with an error and exit code `1`

Fixed the prompt cursor drifting away from the end of the text after emoji such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, or scripts with combining marks such as Devanagari and Thai, especially inside `tmux`, and fixed prompt wrapping splitting such characters across two lines

Fixed the agent hanging when it tried to view a pipe, socket, or device file, and a conversation getting stuck with `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors after the agent viewed a truncated MP4, MOV, or M4A recording; both are now rejected up front with a clear message
Fixed resuming a conversation whose history had a missing step, for example after a crash or an interrupted write, hiding the most recent steps and letting new messages overwrite them

title.zh-TW: 設定選單新增排隊選項，可隨時插話打斷對話
title.en: Settings Menu Adds Queue Option to Interrupt Conversations Anytime

body.zh-TW:
當你看到助理正朝錯誤方向執行長任務時，現在可以直接插話叫停。⟦跟看著助手搬錯箱子時直接出聲喊停一樣，以前只能等他把整批貨搬完才能交代新指令，現在一開口就能立刻打斷他。⟧你可以在 `/config` 選單找到 `Queued Messages` 選項。保持預設的 `Queue` 會把補充訊息暫存到當前輪次結束，切換成 `Send Immediately` 則能立即中斷助理。這項偏好也能直接寫入全域設定檔 `settings.json`，修正了以往寫入該設定卻被系統忽略的問題：
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```
body.en:
When you see your assistant heading in the wrong direction during a long task, you can now speak up and stop it directly. ⟦Think of calling out to stop a helper carrying the wrong box: previously you had to wait until the entire shipment was moved to issue new instructions, but now you can interrupt immediately.⟧ You can find the `Queued Messages` option in the `/config` menu. Keeping the default `Queue` buffers follow-up messages until the current turn ends, while switching to `Send Immediately` interrupts the assistant right away. This preference can also be written directly to the global configuration file `settings.json`, fixing an issue where writing this setting previously got ignored by the system:
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```

items.original: Added the `Queued Messages` option to `/config`: keep the default `Queue` to hold follow-up messages until the current turn ends, or choose `Send Immediately` to interrupt the agent with them; it can also be set with `"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"` in `settings.json`, which was previously ignored

title.zh-TW: Linux 容器環境支援遠端控制，沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員也能背景啟動
title.en: Remote Control Now Supported in Linux Containers, Starting in Background Without systemd User Service Manager

body.zh-TW: 當你在輕量 Docker 環境裡想要連線操作時，過去常因底層缺少自動託管機制而直接碰壁卡關。⟦彷彿在沒有自動排班系統的小型倉庫裡改由工人手動輪值，雖然當機時不會自動重啟、開機也不會自動執行，但依然能把手邊的工作順利跑起來。⟧在沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員（替個人帳號管理背景服務的程式）的 Linux 機器上執行 `remote-control start` 時，現在會直接將常駐程式以背景行程啟動，並警告該行程當機後不會自動重啟且開機時不會自動載入。你隨時能輸入 `remote-control status` 查詢其行程識別碼（PID），需要結束時輸入 `remote-control stop` 即可將其關閉。
body.en: When you want to connect and operate inside a lightweight Docker environment, you previously hit a wall because the underlying system lacked an automated hosting mechanism. ⟦Picture running a small warehouse without an automated scheduling system by having workers take manual shifts: although it will not automatically restart on crashes or launch on boot, it still keeps your current work running smoothly.⟧ When running `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager (a program that manages background services for a user account), the daemon now starts directly as a background process, warning that the process will not restart on crash or launch on boot. You can enter `remote-control status` anytime to check its process ID (PID), and enter `remote-control stop` whenever you need to shut it down.

items.original: Improved `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager, such as most containers: instead of failing, it now starts the daemon as a background process and warns that it will not restart after a crash or start at boot; `remote-control status` shows its PID and `remote-control stop` shuts it down

title.zh-TW: 長對話載入更快，缺步歷程不再覆寫舊進度
title.en: Long Conversations Load Faster, and Histories with Missing Steps No Longer Overwrite Old Progress

body.zh-TW: 當你接續聊了很久的繁重工作階段，或是中途遇上當機想接回紀錄時，整個流程順暢且安心許多。⟦如同翻開厚重日記時直接跳到最新的書籤頁，不必每次都從第一頁逐字掃描，就算中間曾掉了一頁，後續記錄也絕不會錯位覆蓋。⟧重啟擁有數千步驟的對話時，命令列介面不再預先逐步掃描，載入速度明顯加快。歷程若曾因當機或寫入中斷而出現遺漏步驟，恢復時不會再隱藏最新內容，更不會讓新訊息意外覆寫舊紀錄。自動產生的對話標題現在也會將首則訊息附加的圖片與檔案納入考量，純傳截圖或檔案的請求也能擁有具體的標題。
body.en: When you resume a heavy, long-running session or reconnect to your history after a crash, the entire workflow is noticeably smoother and safer. ⟦A reader opening a thick journal jumps straight to the newest bookmarked page without scanning word-by-word from the start, ensuring later entries never misalign or overwrite old notes even if a page went missing.⟧ When restarting conversations with thousands of steps, the command-line interface no longer pre-scans step-by-step, significantly speeding up load times. If history was missing steps due to crashes or interrupted writes, resuming will no longer hide the latest content, nor will new messages accidentally overwrite old records. Auto-generated conversation titles now also factor in images and files attached to the first message, giving concrete titles to requests that only include screenshots or files.

items.original:
Improved loading long conversations: resuming a conversation with thousands of steps is noticeably faster because the CLI no longer scans every step up front
Improved automatically generated conversation titles to take images and files attached to your first message into account, so screenshot- or file-driven requests get specific titles and messages with only attachments get a title too
Fixed resuming a conversation whose history had a missing step, for example after a crash or an interrupted write, hiding the most recent steps and letting new messages overwrite them

title.zh-TW: 帳號違規遭封鎖時，登入錯誤提示附上申訴連結
title.en: Login Error Prompts Include Appeal Links When Accounts Are Blocked for Violations

body.zh-TW: 早上一開工卻被擋在門外，畫面上只寫著因違反服務條款（Terms of Service）遭到停權，常讓人不知道該去哪裡詢問。以前遇到帳號受阻只能看見失敗提示，摸不清該找誰處理；現在登入失敗的錯誤訊息裡會直接附上申訴連結，讓你能立刻點擊網址提交說明。⟦就像門禁卡突然失效時，感應機不再只發出逼逼警告聲，而是直接在螢幕上顯示管理室的服務電話與分機。⟧
body.en: Starting your morning only to find yourself locked out, with a screen stating your account has been suspended for violating the Terms of Service, often leaves you wondering where to turn. Previously, encountering a blocked account only showed a generic failure message with no clear contact point; now, login failure error messages directly include an appeal link, letting you click the URL immediately to submit an explanation. ⟦Instead of merely beeping when an access card fails, a card reader now displays the management office phone number and extension directly on its screen.⟧

items.original: Improved the sign-in error shown to accounts blocked for a Terms of Service violation, which now includes a link to submit an appeal

title.zh-TW: `--json-schema` 啟動時嚴格檢查，根層級非物件立即報錯
title.en: `--json-schema` Strictly Validated at Startup, Failing Immediately If Root Level Is Not an Object

body.zh-TW: 當你為指令傳入結構描述時，若格式有誤或檔案遺失，系統在啟動階段就會立即攔截。⟦好比海關在登機門前嚴格核對護照格式，發現拿的是白紙、寫錯代碼或缺件就當場拒絕通行，而不是放行登機後才引發混亂。⟧參數 `--json-schema` 不再將純文字、單獨型態名稱（如 `string`）或不存在的結構描述檔默默當成字串型態處理。現在只要輸入上述無效內容，或是根層級不是物件（`"type": "object"`）的結構描述，程式在啟動時就會直接輸出錯誤訊息並以結束代碼 `1` 中斷退出。
body.en: When you pass a schema to a command, the system now intercepts formatting errors or missing files right at startup. ⟦Customs officers strictly check passport formats at the boarding gate, turning away blank paper, mistyped codes, or missing documents on the spot rather than causing chaos after boarding.⟧ The `--json-schema` parameter no longer silently treats plain text, bare type names (such as `string`), or non-existent schema files as string types. Supplying any of these invalid inputs, or a schema whose root level is not an object (`"type": "object"`), now causes the program to output an error message at startup and exit immediately with exit code `1`.

items.original: Changed `--json-schema` to reject plain text, bare type names such as `string`, and missing schema files instead of silently treating them as a string schema; these inputs, and any schema whose root is not `"type": "object"`, now fail at startup with an error and exit code `1`

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示不再游標偏離，表情符號與特殊文字換行不割裂
title.en: Prompt Input Eliminates Cursor Drift, Keeping Emojis and Complex Characters Intact Across Line Wraps

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入特殊字元或在多重視窗中作業時，游標位置與文字折行現在能精準對齊。⟦就像使用排版工具編輯圖文，以前遇到複雜貼圖或組合文字時游標會飄到半空中、換行還會把圖案切成兩半，現在游標與字元邊界都緊緊貼合。⟧修復了在提示列輸入 ⚠️ 或 👩‍💻 等表情符號，以及天城文（Devanagari）與泰文等組合字元時游標尾端偏離的問題，特別是在 `tmux` 環境下更是如此。當文字過長自動折行時，也不會再將這類特殊字元拆散切成兩行顯示。
body.en: When entering special characters in the terminal or working across multiplexed windows, cursor positioning and text wrapping now align precisely. ⟦Like laying out text and graphics in a publishing tool where complex stickers previously floated the cursor into mid-air and line breaks sliced graphics in half, the cursor and character boundaries now fit tightly together.⟧ Fixed trailing cursor drift when entering emojis such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, as well as combining characters like Devanagari and Thai in the prompt line, especially inside `tmux` environments. When long text wraps automatically, it will also no longer split these special characters across two lines.

items.original: Fixed the prompt cursor drifting away from the end of the text after emoji such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, or scripts with combining marks such as Devanagari and Thai, especially inside `tmux`, and fixed prompt wrapping splitting such characters across two lines

title.zh-TW: 檢視管線裝置與損毀影音不再卡死，事前攔截並清楚提示
title.en: Inspecting Pipe Devices and Corrupted Media No Longer Hangs, Intercepting Early with Clear Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當助理嘗試讀取特殊系統檔案或不完整的影音錄影時，對話不會再陷入無止境的等待或報錯。⟦宛如播放器遇到未下載完成的影片或特殊資料通道時直接提示檔案損毀，而不是整台機器當機轉圈圈。⟧以前助理若嘗試檢視管線（pipe）、通訊端或裝置檔等特殊檔案，流程很容易直接卡死。檢視未錄製完整的 MP4、MOV 或 M4A 影音檔時，對話也會陷入無效引數（`INVALID_ARGUMENT`）錯誤而無法繼續。現在遇到這兩類檔案時，系統會在讀取前直接攔截並給出明確的提示訊息。
body.en: When the assistant attempts to read special system files or incomplete audiovisual recordings, conversations no longer get trapped in endless waiting or error states. ⟦A media player encountering an incomplete video download or a special data stream alerts you to file corruption directly instead of freezing the entire machine with a spinning wheel.⟧ Previously, if the assistant tried to inspect special files such as pipes, sockets, or device files, the process easily hung completely. Inspecting incompletely recorded MP4, MOV, or M4A media files also threw `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors that blocked the conversation from continuing. When encountering either type of file, the system now intercepts before reading and provides a clear prompt.

items.original: Fixed the agent hanging when it tried to view a pipe, socket, or device file, and a conversation getting stuck with `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors after the agent viewed a truncated MP4, MOV, or M4A recording; both are now rejected up front with a clear message

entries: **Resuming a stale conversation now tells you what it will cost.** When Progress Concierge is on and you `/resume` (or `--resume` / `--continue`) a conversation whose prompt cache has expired and whose context is at least 50k tokens, Claude Code shows a one-line warning before your first message: how long it sat idle, roughly how many tokens the next message re-sends, and a suggestion to `/compact` first. Only you see it; it is never added to Claude's context. Needs Claude Code 2.1.251 or newer. Existing installs pick up the new trigger automatically the next time usage starts.

**The status line now says what a cold cache will cost.** Once the prompt cache countdown runs out, the segment switches to how many tokens the next message will re-cache (for example `cold·re-cache 180k`) instead of going blank. Claude Code redraws the status line the moment the cache expires, so no refresh interval is needed.
Quota warning and quota-depleted notifications now play a short two-note "uh-oh" alert sound made for usage. The quota-restored notification keeps the system default sound.

**Claude subagent output was undercounted by about 86%.** Claude Code writes each subagent request to its transcript several times while it streams, and `output_tokens` only reaches its final value on the last line. Both Claude parsers kept the first line, so on one machine 17 subagent transcripts counted 23,327 output tokens instead of 165,395. They now keep the largest value for each request. Main-conversation transcripts were not affected. The history and yearly caches are rebuilt once; days whose transcripts were already deleted keep their archived totals and cannot be corrected.

Add Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) to the offline fallback price table, so its usage is no longer priced at $0 when the downloaded price table is stale, and show it as "Sonnet 5.5" in tables instead of a truncated model ID.

title.zh-TW: 接回舊對話與狀態列即時提醒，快取過期成本一目了然
title.en: Resuming Old Conversations with Real-Time Status Line Alerts Makes Cache Expiration Costs Clear

body.zh-TW: 當你暫停工作後想接續先前任務，常因快取（暫存計算結果的機制）過期而重送大量資料。開啟進度管家後，只要以 `/resume`、`--resume` 或 `--continue` 接回過期且脈絡達 5 萬 token（AI 計費的文字單位）的對話，Claude Code 會在輸入首句前顯示一行提示，列出閒置時間、預估重送的 token 數並建議先執行 `/compact`。此提示僅自己可見且不計入脈絡，需 2.1.251 以上版本且下次啟動 usage 自動套用。狀態列在倒數結束後也不再留白，到期當下會即時重畫，顯示如 `cold·re-cache 180k` 的提示，表示下一則訊息約有 18 萬 token 要重新快取。⟦如同退房時櫃檯即時試算加時費用，以前超時往往結帳才發現驚人帳單，現在一到超時點就主動亮出補收標準，讓你能提前評估是否精簡內容。⟧
body.en: When resuming previous tasks after taking a break, users often resend large amounts of data due to expired caches. With Progress Manager enabled, whenever you resume an expired conversation with at least 50k tokens of context using `/resume`, `--resume`, or `--continue`, Claude Code displays a single-line notice before you enter your first prompt. This notice details the idle duration and the estimated number of tokens to resend, while suggesting that you run `/compact` first. Visible only to you, this prompt is excluded from context, requires version 2.1.251 or later, and applies automatically the next time usage launches. The status line also no longer goes blank when the countdown ends. Instead, it redraws immediately upon expiration to show prompts like `cold·re-cache 180k`, indicating that the next message will re-cache approximately 180k tokens. ⟦Picture a hotel front desk calculating overtime charges the moment checkout passes: instead of discovering a surprise bill at final settlement, you immediately see the extra fees and can decide in advance whether to trim your stay.⟧

title.zh-TW: 額度快用完改播專屬短音，告急提醒更具辨識度
title.en: Distinct Chimes for Dwindling Quotas Make Low-Quota Alerts Instantly Recognizable

body.zh-TW: 埋頭趕工或專注思考時，如果沒有時常緊盯著用量面板，額度（特定週期內可使用的調用配額上限）見底的瞬間往往讓人猝不及防。現在系統調整了通知音效，當額度快用完或已經用完時，會改播 usage 自製的兩聲「uh-oh」簡短警示音，讓你光聽聲音就能分辨用量告急。至於額度恢復時的通知，則繼續維持播放系統預設的提示音，避免干擾既有的使用習慣。⟦洗衣機遇到排水故障時用短促警示，洗好衣服則播放一般完成音；現在額度告急有專屬短音，額度恢復仍是系統預設音，光聽就能分辨。⟧
body.en: When rushing through work or deep in thought, running out of quota without watching the usage popover can easily catch you off guard. The system has now updated its notification sounds. Whenever quota is running low or fully exhausted, usage plays a custom two-tone "uh-oh" short alert, letting you recognize the urgent status by sound alone. Notifications for quota recovery continue to play the default system chime, preserving your established workflow habits. ⟦A washing machine beeps with a sharp warning when drainage fails but plays a standard completion chime when the cycle finishes smoothly. In the same way, quota exhaustion now triggers a dedicated short tone while recovery uses the default system sound, making them distinguishable by ear alone.⟧

items.original: Quota warning and quota-depleted notifications now play a short two-note "uh-oh" alert sound made for usage. The quota-restored notification keeps the system default sound.

title.zh-TW: 修正子代理輸出少算問題，歷史快取自動重新結算
title.en: Fixing Undercounted Subagent Outputs and Automatically Recalculating Historical Caches

body.zh-TW: 習慣呼叫多個背景助手平行處理繁重任務的使用者，過去看到的用量統計可能嚴重失真。先前在串流（答案一邊生成一邊逐字傳輸的輸出方式）處理時，Claude Code 會把同一請求多次寫入日誌，導致解析器只抓到第一行，使子代理的輸出用量少算約 86%。例如在某台機器上的 17 個子代理日誌中，原本僅記錄到 23,327 個輸出 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），修正後改取每筆請求的最大值，實際數值應為 165,395。這項問題只影響子代理，主對話日誌完全不受影響；更新後歷史快取與年度快取會自動重算一次，但日誌已遭刪除的日期則維持封存數字無法補正。⟦好比收銀機結帳時印出整串明細，以前系統只抓取了剛開始印出的第一行小計，導致整筆交易總額嚴重短少；現在改以最終印出的加總金額為準，歷史紀錄重新結算後用量數字終於回歸真實。⟧
body.en: Users accustomed to spawning multiple background assistants for parallel tasks may have previously seen severely skewed usage statistics. During streaming responses, Claude Code wrote the same request to logs multiple times. This caused the parser to capture only the first line, undercounting subagent output usage by about 86%. For example, across 17 subagent logs on one machine, only 23,327 output tokens were initially recorded; after switching to taking the maximum value per request, the actual count was 165,395. This issue affected only subagents, leaving main session logs completely untouched. After the update, historical and annual caches are automatically recalculated once, though dates whose logs were deleted remain archived and cannot be retroactively fixed. ⟦Think of a cash register printing a long receipt where the system previously captured only the first line of subtotal, causing the recorded total to fall drastically short. By taking the final printed sum instead, historical records are recalculated and usage numbers reflect reality at last.⟧

Both Claude parsers kept the first line, so on one machine 17 subagent transcripts counted 23,327 output tokens instead of 165,395. They now keep the largest value for each request. Main-conversation transcripts were not affected. The history and yearly caches are rebuilt once; days whose transcripts were already deleted keep their archived totals and cannot be corrected.

title.zh-TW: 離線備用價目表補上 Sonnet 5.5，名稱顯示不再截斷
title.en: Offline Fallback Pricing Adds Sonnet 5.5 and Fixes Truncated Model Names

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或離線環境工作時，最怕計費工具因連不上伺服器而無法正確計算新型號的花費。現在離線備援（主要機制失效時接手的後備清單）價目表正式補上了新模型資料，完整納入 `claude-sonnet-5-5` 的費率。以前當下載的線上價目表過期時，這款模型的用量會被誤算為 0 美元；現在即使離線也能依正確標準計價，終端機表格中也會顯示為清晰的「Sonnet 5.5」，不再出現被截斷的模型識別碼。⟦彷彿隨身攜帶的紙本價目表補齊了最新熱門品項，以前網路斷線時查不到新餐點價格會直接被當成免費招待，現在備援清單完整對齊，就算離線結算也不會漏算費用。⟧
body.en: When working offline or during network outages, cost tracking tools often fail to price new models accurately without server access. The offline fallback pricing table now officially incorporates new model data, fully including rates for `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Previously, when the downloaded online pricing expired, usage for this model was miscalculated as $0. Now it is priced correctly even offline, and terminal tables clearly display "Sonnet 5.5" rather than a truncated model identifier. ⟦Like a printed menu updated with the newest popular dishes, where disconnected servers previously treated unknown items as free on the house, the fallback list is now fully aligned so offline calculations never miss a charge.⟧

items.original: Add Sonnet 5.5 (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) to the offline fallback price table, so its usage is no longer priced at $0 when the downloaded price table is stale, and show it as "Sonnet 5.5" in tables instead of a truncated model ID.

## Security

Four security vulnerabilities have been identified, and fixed, in this release. Users are advised to update gh to version `v2.102.0` as soon as possible.

`gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` could write remote content to an unintended local file when the destination contained symbolic links.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-39wj-f2f4-978v for more information.

`gh attestation verify` compared the `--source-ref` value case-insensitively, so an attestation built from a branch whose name differs only in case could satisfy a policy that named a different branch.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-4mq3-hpgx-9cx8 for more information.

Interactive `gh skill search` passed repository paths from search results to `gh skill install` without an option separator, so a search result could inject installer options and change where skill files were written.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-qcwj-mr2r-2cx7 for more information.

`gh attestation verify` matched the `--signer-workflow` value against only the start of the signing certificate's identity, so an attestation signed by a different workflow in the pinned repository could pass verification when its path began with the pinned value.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-wjmr-j3rp-mh2g for more information.

title.zh-TW: 修復四處安全漏洞，防範非預期檔案寫入與驗證被繞過
title.en: Fix Four Security Vulnerabilities to Prevent Unexpected File Writes and Verification Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 下載、安裝技能或驗證產物時不再受惡意名稱所害，建議盡快升到 `v2.102.0`。`gh release download`、`gh run download`、`gh repo read-file --output` 與 `gh attestation download` 遇目的地含符號連結（指向其他位置的捷徑檔）時，以前可能寫入非預期的本機檔案。`gh attestation verify` 以前比對 `--source-ref` 不分大小寫，且 `--signer-workflow` 只比憑證身分開頭，僅大小寫不同的分支，或同儲存庫內路徑開頭相同的另一個工作流程，都可能通過驗證。互動式 `gh skill search` 傳路徑給 `gh skill install` 時缺少選項分隔符號，搜尋結果可能注入安裝選項並改寫檔案位置。⟦就像同一棟樓四扇門的鎖被一次補好。⟧
body.en: Downloading artifacts, installing skills, or verifying attestations is no longer vulnerable to malicious names, and upgrading to `v2.102.0` as soon as possible is recommended. When the destination contains a symlink, `gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` previously risked writing to unintended local files. `gh attestation verify` previously compared `--source-ref` case-insensitively and only matched the prefix of certificate identities for `--signer-workflow`, allowing branches differing only by case or another workflow with a matching path prefix in the same repository to pass verification. Interactive `gh skill search` lacked an option delimiter when passing paths to `gh skill install`, which allowed search results to inject installation options and alter file locations. ⟦Picture locks on four doors of the same building being fixed all at once.⟧
